notes: scripted real browser, not a volunteer. Headless Chromium 159 (Playwright) driven through the local stack (Caddy :8080 -> demo site) on Sat, 21 Nov 2026 11:56:21 GMT: follows nav/product links, searches with typed queries (o'brien, c++, rock & roll, cafe with accent, 50% off, quoted phrase...), adds to cart, logs in (POST /login), checks out, logs out; think times compressed to uniform 1-4 s, typing 60-180 ms/char, up to 6 sessions concurrent. Post-processing: client_ip/remote_ip rewritten from 127.0.0.1 to 198.51.100.N (one per session) and a per-session recorder token removed from User-Agent; the UA was overridden to a non-headless Chrome/159 string, but Sec-Ch-Ua still names HeadlessChrome. 502s on a few assets are real: the demo backend reset connections while other recorders loaded it. Demo site sends no cache headers, so assets reload on every page. Labeled human because it imitates human browsing; it is not human data.
